headline:
START WITH A RUN.
SEE WHERE IT GOES.
support: Start with fitness. Stay for the connection.
coreStory: START WITH A SHARED ACTIVITY. BUILD A REAL CONNECTION. SEE WHERE IT GOES.
emotionalArc: Train together → vibe → date → maybe more (friendship, romance, marriage). Never promise outcomes.
visualBar: Young, attractive athletic man + woman, clear shared activity, natural chemistry looking at each other, aspirational lifestyle photography — not coaching, clipboard, schoolteacher, older stock, or railroad AI.
logic: beautiful people who fit TRAIN → VIBE → DATE
note: Sep 16 Facebook post is the visual quality bar. Copy QUALITY and LOGIC — not the same sport/people daily.
